promise: We are going to have a 48-team World Cup.
description: FIFA Council unanimously voted to expand the World Cup to 48 teams (announced for 2026 after the 2022 tournament stayed at 32). The expanded 48-team tournament kicked off June 11, 2026 in North America.
evidence: FIFA Council unanimously voted for a 48-team format on 2017-01-10
2026 World Cup in USA/Canada/Mexico ran with 48 teams as promised

promise: Provide Ukraine $3.39 billion in budget support under the First Jobs and Private Sector Growth Development Policy Operation
description: On June 24, 2026, on the sidelines of the Ukraine Recovery Conference in Gdańsk, Ukraine and the World Bank signed agreements worth $3.39 billion — including a $1.04 billion development policy loan, partly guaranteed by the UK and Japan, and about $2.35 billion in grants — to support the state budget and advance reforms. Ukraine received $3.35 billion into its state budget under the operation, with the receipt announced on July 9, 2026.
evidence: Ukraine confirmed receipt of $3.35 billion into the state budget, announced July 9, 2026
